description: This PHP class 'TemplateParent' extends 'TemplateEnum' and defines a form field template for handling parent record references within SuiteCRM's dynamic fields system. The class includes methods for generating field definitions, saving, and deleting related sub-fields like 'parent_type' and 'parent_id'.

classes.name: TemplateParent
classes.description: Defines a dynamic 'parent' field type with methods for setting up related sub-fields and field definitions.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, including type name, id, parent type, source, and studio visibility.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the parent type and parent ID sub-fields associated with this field.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the main field and its related sub-fields for parent type and parent ID, configuring labels and importable status.

methods.name: get_db_add_alter_table
methods.description: Returns an empty string; No database schema change needed for adding this field.

methods.name: get_db_modify_alter_table
methods.description: Returns an empty string; No database schema change needed for modifying this field.
